scope: Correct only the interpretation of the V18 deterministic screen-space normal during standalone CPU feasibility diagnosis. The clockwise normal defines an oriented axis, and the diagnostic must exhaustively generate candidates on both signed sides of that axis before output-only repair matching. This correction does not authorize product implementation, production, CMake, GPU, readiness, capture or acceptance.

root_clarification_binding.statement: ROOT CLARIFICATION: fixed clockwise normal defines a deterministic oriented axis; V18 must enumerate both signed +/- sides. Side cannot be selected by coordinates, probe IDs or repair IDs; candidate comparison records signed side only after the geometry/safety rank, and any equal best geometry rank across opposite sides fails closed.

supersession.corrected_interpretation: The fixed clockwise perpendicular establishes a stable oriented normal axis. Candidate generation covers signed negative and signed positive displacement along that axis; the prior gate must not be read as authorizing positive-side-only generation.
preserved_without_change: complete coordinate-free full-frame semantic silhouette inventory before coordinates, contrast probes or repair IDs
exact semantic batch, nonzero finalOwnershipToken, track, arcSegmentId and exact primitive association with ordered member-token retention
bounded connected overlap or one-sample-lattice near/coaxial relationship components
complete protected predicted core, inner and outer silhouette non-occlusion
exact standard and color-vision-safe 1x, 2x and 4x profiles for all three repair regions
exact 81 contrast-probe order/digest and three repair IDs as post-generation regression and matcher inputs only
no source, token, batch, primitive, arc, route, width, cap, offset, color or product geometry mutation
future GL query, upload and consecutive-frame state failures must fail closed
no production, CMake, GPU, readiness, capture or acceptance authorization

signed_axis_generation_contract.axis_construction: Normalize the predicted route-order direction over the bounded component interval. Its fixed top-left-screen clockwise perpendicular is the positive normal; its exact negation is the negative side of the same oriented axis.
signed_axis_generation_contract.generation_order: For every full-frame eligible relationship component and sample profile, enumerate the complete finite route-order leave/rejoin lattice and every bounded normal shell on both signed sides, freeze counts and a canonical all-candidate digest, and only then expose coordinates/probes/repair IDs to the matcher.

selection_and_ambiguity_contract.safety_predicate_precedes_ranking: A candidate enters ranking only if both actual-attributed halves are paired, graph-traceable, removal-sensitive and sample-resolved zero-overlap against the complete protected predicted silhouette.
selection_and_ambiguity_contract.signed_side_recording: Signed side is retained immediately after the geometry/safety rank in the canonical candidate key and all-candidate digest. It is provenance for audit, never a preferred side or a tie-break supplied by output data.
selection_and_ambiguity_contract.topology_digest_recording: Canonical topology digest follows signed side for deterministic inventory ordering and same-side candidate comparison.
selection_and_ambiguity_contract.cross_side_equal_best_rule: After safety filtering and geometry ranking, if the equal best geometry rank contains eligible candidates from both signed sides, the component is ambiguous and fails closed before signed side or topology digest can choose a winner.
selection_and_ambiguity_contract.same_side_unique_minimum_rule: If the best geometry rank exists on one signed side only, the original canonical topology comparison may select one unique minimum; duplicate/equal canonical minima still fail closed.

required_fail_closed_fixtures: positive and negative signed sides are both generated from the same fixed clockwise normal axis without coordinates, probes or repair IDs
removing either signed side changes the all-candidate inventory digest and is rejected
negating the clockwise normal only relabels signed sides canonically and cannot change the unordered eligible geometry inventory
output coordinate, repair ID, contrast probe, palette, color and prior-result mutations cannot alter signed candidate generation or ranking
equal best geometry rank across opposite signed sides fails closed before signed side or topology digest ordering
one safe side and one unsafe side selects only the safe side after complete protected-silhouette testing
same-side duplicate canonical minimum fails closed
old fixed-midpoint leave/rejoin rejection cannot hide a nearer safe route-lattice candidate
all valid candidates contribute to a frozen canonical digest even when only current minima are retained in memory
complete protected predicted silhouette zero-overlap is checked at every 1x, 2x and 4x sample for both sides
standard and color-vision-safe signed candidate inventories and topology are identical
exact 18 cases and post-generation exact 81 probe digest plus three repair IDs remain unchanged
five production and CMake baselines remain exact and source/token/batch/primitive/arc inventories do not grow
